dialogue.content: こんばんは、今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お願いいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが始めさせていただいてもよろしいですか？それともジャストの方がよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: It’s a bit early, but would it be alright if we begin? Or would you prefer to start right on time?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です（今日は自殺対策事前研修で扱ったものをやらせていただきたいですよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: That's fine. (Today, I'd like to role-play a scenario from the suicide prevention pre-training. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: 大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that alright?

dialogue.content: はい、承知いたしましたまだ未経験ですので頑張ってみます
dialogue.English: Yes, understood. I'm still inexperienced, but I'll do my best.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for speaking with me.

dialogue.content: はいでは、研修は受けていらっしゃらないということですね
dialogue.English: Okay, so you haven’t taken the training, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 高校生と50だいのかたどちらがよいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would you prefer I play a high school student or someone in their 50s?

dialogue.content: お任せいたします
dialogue.English: I’ll leave it up to you.

dialogue.content: では女子高生で
dialogue.English: Then I'll be a high school girl.

dialogue.content: 承知いたしました
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: アムカがやめられないんです
dialogue.English: I can’t stop cutting my arms.

dialogue.content: わたしどうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: わたし死んでもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay if I die?

dialogue.content: 大変失礼ですが、アムカとは何かお聞きしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Excuse my ignorance, but may I ask what 'amuka' is?

dialogue.content: リスカがリストカットアムカはアームカット腕を切るとのことです
dialogue.English: “Riska” means wrist-cutting, and “amuka” means arm-cutting—cutting one’s arms.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとございます最初になんとお呼びしたらよいかお聞きしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for explaining that. To start, may I ask what I should call you?

dialogue.content: りんごでお願いします
dialogue.English: Please call me Ringo.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますりんごさんはアムカをいつからなさってるのですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you, Ringo. How long have you been cutting your arms?

dialogue.content: 高校入ってから
dialogue.English: Since I started high school.

dialogue.content: 毎日つまんないし
dialogue.English: And every day is so boring.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね・・・今は何処にいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: I see... Where are you right now?

dialogue.content: 今はホテル
dialogue.English: I’m at a hotel right now.

dialogue.content: ホテルでお一人ですか？
dialogue.English: Are you alone at the hotel?

dialogue.content: 今はひとり
dialogue.English: I’m alone right now.

dialogue.content: 何がみえてますか？
dialogue.English: What can you see around you?

dialogue.content: 援交してたらAV出演迫られた
dialogue.English: I was doing compensated dating, and they tried to force me to be in an adult video.

dialogue.content: なにそれ？
dialogue.English: Like, what's that about?

dialogue.content: そんなことまでしないとダメなの？
dialogue.English: Do I really have to do something like that?

dialogue.content: もう無理
dialogue.English: I can't take it anymore.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさいねお気を悪くしてしまいましたね
dialogue.English: I’m sorry, I must have upset you.

dialogue.content: OD(オーバードーズ薬の大量服用)やったら楽になりますよね
dialogue.English: If I overdose (take a large amount of medication), it would make things easier, right?

dialogue.content: りんごさんの目に見えてるものを私も想像したかったのです
dialogue.English: I just wanted to imagine what you're seeing through your eyes, Ringo.

dialogue.content: 学校つまんなくて
dialogue.English: School is so boring.

dialogue.content: 今、手元にお薬はあるの？
dialogue.English: Do you have the pills with you right now?

dialogue.content: 持ってる50錠ぐらい
dialogue.English: I do. About 50 pills.

dialogue.content: それなら死ねるのかな
dialogue.English: I wonder if that's enough to die.

dialogue.content: やっぱり苦しいのかな
dialogue.English: Would it still be painful?

dialogue.content: なんのお薬か教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what kind of pills they are?

dialogue.content: 睡眠薬って聞いてるよ
dialogue.English: I heard they're sleeping pills.

dialogue.content: 知らないけど
dialogue.English: But I don't know for sure.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね教えてくれてありがとう
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.content: もうこんな人生嫌だ
dialogue.English: I'm so tired of this life.

dialogue.content: 今日は援交するためにホテルにきたの？
dialogue.English: Did you come to the hotel today for compensated dating?

dialogue.content: そうだった
dialogue.English: Yeah, that was the plan.

dialogue.content: 学校行ってもつまんないし
dialogue.English: And going to school is just boring.

dialogue.content: お金はいくらもらったのかしら？
dialogue.English: How much money did you receive?

dialogue.content: そこ聞く？
dialogue.English: You’re asking that?

dialogue.content: なんか関係ある？死ぬのと
dialogue.English: What does that have to do with me dying?

dialogue.content: 関係ない質問してしまいましたねごめんなさい
dialogue.English: That was an irrelevant question. I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 時間潰すのも大変になってきた
dialogue.English: It's even gotten hard just to kill time.

dialogue.content: 時間つぶしだったのですね
dialogue.English: So you were just killing time.

dialogue.content: やることないし
dialogue.English: There's nothing else to do.

dialogue.content: でもAVはねさすがにいやだ
dialogue.English: But being in an adult video... that's just too much.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね学校もつまらないし・・・AVは嫌ですよね流石に
dialogue.English: I see. School is boring... And yes, being in an adult video is definitely something you wouldn't want to do.

dialogue.content: そこまでして生きなきゃなんないの？
dialogue.English: Do I have to go that far just to keep living?

dialogue.content: なんか毎日意味わかんなくて
dialogue.English: I just don't get the point of anything anymore.

dialogue.content: そんなに辛くなる前は何してる時が好きだった？
dialogue.English: Before things got this hard, what did you enjoy doing?

dialogue.content: 前？ずっと昔からだけど
dialogue.English: Before? It's been like this for a very long time.

dialogue.content: ずっと辛い日々を送ってこられたのですね
dialogue.English: So you've been having such a hard time for so long.

dialogue.content: 中学の時は担任の先生は話できて楽しかった
dialogue.English: In middle school, I enjoyed talking to my homeroom teacher.

dialogue.content: 相談できたし
dialogue.English: I could confide in them.

dialogue.content: でももうそれもないし
dialogue.English: But I don't have that anymore.

dialogue.content: 中学の担任の先生とはもうあえてないのかしら？
dialogue.English: Are you not able to see your middle school teacher anymore?

dialogue.content: うんあってない
dialogue.English: No, I haven’t seen them.

dialogue.content: それは辛いね・・・高校は嫌な事ばかりなのですね
dialogue.English: That must be hard... It sounds like high school is just full of unpleasant things.

dialogue.content: そうだね合わないって感じ
dialogue.English: Yeah. It feels like it's not a good fit for me.

dialogue.content: 合わないのに頑張っていってるんですね
dialogue.English: Even though it's not a good fit, you're still trying hard to go.

dialogue.content: 行ってない日が多いかな
dialogue.English: I probably miss more days than I attend.

dialogue.content: そうなのね休みたい時は休むのが一番ね
dialogue.English: I see. It's best to rest when you feel like you need to.

dialogue.content: 公園とか街で時間潰してる
dialogue.English: I just kill time in parks or wandering around town.

dialogue.content: 時間つぶしも大変っていってましたね
dialogue.English: You mentioned that even killing time has become hard.

dialogue.content: やることないから
dialogue.English: Because there’s nothing to do.

dialogue.content: りんごさんは、一人行動が多いのかな？
dialogue.English: Ringo, do you spend a lot of time on your own?

dialogue.content: そうだね
dialogue.English: Yeah, I do.

dialogue.content: それは暇ももてあましてしまうね
dialogue.English: That must leave you with a lot of time on your hands.

dialogue.content: だからもう死んだ方が楽かなって思ってる
dialogue.English: That’s why I think it might be easier to just die.

dialogue.content: 一匹狼派なのねかっこいいっとも思えるけど
dialogue.English: So you're a bit of a lone wolf. I can see that as being cool.

dialogue.content: カッコ良くてやってるつもりはないんだけど
dialogue.English: I'm not trying to be cool.

dialogue.content: 仲間がいないだけ
dialogue.English: I just don’t have any friends.

dialogue.content: そうなんだねそれは辛いね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be tough.

dialogue.content: 辛いっていうかなんだろう
dialogue.English: It's not that it's tough, it's more like...

dialogue.content: りんごさん！
dialogue.English: Ringo!

dialogue.content: こんなことまでして生きなきゃいけない意味がわからない
dialogue.English: I don't understand the point of having to do all this just to stay alive.

dialogue.content: 私、中学の担任の先生みたいになりたいのだけど候補にいれてもらえるかしら
dialogue.English: I’d like to become like your junior high homeroom teacher—could you consider me as a candidate?

dialogue.content: 話付き合ってくれるってこと？
dialogue.English: You mean you’ll talk with me?

dialogue.content: 勿論！そうなりたいからもっとりんごさんの事知りたい
dialogue.English: Of course! I want to be that for you, so I want to get to know you better.

dialogue.content: 知りたいってなにを？
dialogue.English: Get to know what about me?

dialogue.content: りんごさんの好きな食べ物や、嫌いな食べ物音楽とか色々いっぱい知りたい
dialogue.English: I want to know all sorts of things, like the food you like and dislike, the music you listen to... everything.

dialogue.content: 好きなものね
dialogue.English: Things I like, huh.

dialogue.content: 好きな食べ物はやっぱりんご
dialogue.English: My favorite food is apples, of course.

dialogue.content: 嫌いな食べ物は辛いもの
dialogue.English: I dislike spicy food.

dialogue.content: そっか、りんごさんだものね
dialogue.English: Ah, that makes sense, since your name is Ringo.

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 辛い物は辛いものね
dialogue.English: Spicy things are tough, aren't they.

dialogue.content: あ、辛いってつらいとも読むよね
dialogue.English: Oh, and the character for “spicy” can also be read as “painful,” right?

dialogue.content: そうみたいだよね
dialogue.English: Seems like it.

dialogue.content: どっちも同じ
dialogue.English: They’re both the same.

dialogue.content: 漢字はむずかしいね
dialogue.English: Kanji is difficult, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 苦手だけとスマホで出るから
dialogue.English: I'm not good at it, but my phone can type it for me.

dialogue.content: そうだね今は便利な世界だけど生きにくい世界でもあるね
dialogue.English: That's true. It's a convenient world we live in, but it can also be a difficult one to live in.

dialogue.content: そうだね
dialogue.English: Yeah, that's true.

dialogue.content: 音楽は誰が好き？
dialogue.English: What kind of music do you like?

dialogue.content: 今はKing Gnu
dialogue.English: Right now, King Gnu.

dialogue.content: そうなんだちょとづつりんごさんが知れて来て嬉しい
dialogue.English: I see. I'm happy that I'm getting to know you little by little.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんは？
dialogue.English: What about you, counselor?

dialogue.content: 卍ラインかな
dialogue.English: I guess Manji Line.

dialogue.content: わかんないわー
dialogue.English: I've never heard of them.

dialogue.content: そっかー窪塚洋介知ってる？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you know Yosuke Kubozuka?

dialogue.content: うんその人は知ってる
dialogue.English: Yeah, I know who he is.

dialogue.content: 今音楽やってるの？
dialogue.English: Is he doing music now?

dialogue.content: かっこいいよね
dialogue.English: He’s cool, isn’t he.

dialogue.content: そ、そその人の音楽名なんだ
dialogue.English: Ye-yes, that's his stage name for his music.

dialogue.content: ひとり？
dialogue.English: Solo?

dialogue.content: そう一人でやってる
dialogue.English: Yes, he performs solo.

dialogue.content: 今度聞いてみて
dialogue.English: Give him a listen sometime.

dialogue.content: うん聞いてみる
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll give it a listen.

dialogue.content: 年いくつぐらいなんだろ
dialogue.English: I wonder how old he is.

dialogue.content: もう４０いったかなでもかっこいいよね
dialogue.English: He might be 40 already, but he's still cool, right?

dialogue.content: そうだよねおじさんだよね
dialogue.English: Yeah, he's an old guy.

dialogue.content: でもかっこいい
dialogue.English: But he’s cool.

dialogue.content: おじさんだねうん、かっこいいおじさん！
dialogue.English: He's an old guy, yeah. A cool old guy!

dialogue.content: りんごさん、今日はどんな服きてるの？
dialogue.English: Ringo, what kind of clothes are you wearing today?

dialogue.content: 今日ははじめ制服着てて私服は持って出たから大したものきてないよ
dialogue.English: I was wearing my school uniform earlier and brought a change of clothes, so I'm not wearing anything special.

dialogue.content: 普通の夏服
dialogue.English: Just regular summer clothes.

dialogue.content: そうなのねどんな服装が好きなのかなって思ってね
dialogue.English: I see. I was just wondering what kind of style you like.

dialogue.content: そこまで興味深くはないかな
dialogue.English: I'm not that into fashion or anything.

dialogue.content: そうなのねちょっとりんごさんのイメージしたかったから聞いてしまった
dialogue.English: I see. I just asked because I wanted to get a better picture of you in my mind.

dialogue.content: 見た目は普通だと思うよ
dialogue.English: I think I look pretty average.

dialogue.content: そうなのねまだまだいっぱい知りたいな
dialogue.English: I see. There's still so much more I want to learn about you.

dialogue.content: 真面目っぽいよ
dialogue.English: I probably look like a serious type.

dialogue.content: 好きな事も嫌いな事も、辛い事も悲しい事もいっぱいいっぱい聞きたいんだ
dialogue.English: I want to hear everything—the things you like, the things you dislike, the things that are painful, the things that are sad.

dialogue.content: これからも聞かせてくれないかな？
dialogue.English: Would you keep sharing with me from here on?

dialogue.content: なに話せるかわからないけど
dialogue.English: I’m not sure what I can talk about, though.

dialogue.content: ありがとう！凄く嬉しい
dialogue.English: Thank you! That makes me so happy.

dialogue.content: じゃ、約束の代わりに一個お願い聞いてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: Then, in exchange for that promise, could you do one thing for me?

dialogue.content: なんだろう
dialogue.English: What is it?

dialogue.content: まだまだこれからもお話していきたいから眠剤だかなんだか訳わからない薬、おトイレに流してくれる？
dialogue.English: I want to keep talking with you for a long time to come, so could you flush those sleeping pills, or whatever they are, down the toilet?

dialogue.content: これは最後のお守りみたいなものだから
dialogue.English: This is like my last resort, my charm.

dialogue.content: 今はむり
dialogue.English: I can't do that right now.

dialogue.content: でも今日は使わない
dialogue.English: But I won’t use them today.

dialogue.content: お守りかうん。じゃ今日は飲まないって聞いたから安心
dialogue.English: A charm, huh... Okay. Well, I'm relieved to hear you won't take them today.

dialogue.content: いっぱいいっぱいまだまだりんごさん知りたいからね
dialogue.English: Because there is still so, so much more I want to know about you.

dialogue.content: わかった
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ありがとう！
dialogue.English: Thank you!

dialogue.content: また明日きてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: Will you come back again tomorrow?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: ありがとう！じゃ約束ね！
dialogue.English: Thank you! It's a promise, then!

dialogue.content: はいわかった
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: 中学の先生の候補になれたかな？＾＾
dialogue.English: Did I make it as a candidate like your junior high teacher? ^^

dialogue.content: どうだろそれは・・・まだわからない
dialogue.English: I wonder about that… I’m not sure yet.

dialogue.content: でもありがとうございました
dialogue.English: But thank you very much.

dialogue.content: そうだねもっとお互い知っていこうねじゃ、明日待ってるね
dialogue.English: You're right. Let's get to know each other more. Well then, I'll be waiting for you tomorrow.

dialogue.content: はいじゃあ今日はこれで終わりですね
dialogue.English: Okay, so we're done for today, then.

dialogue.content: 今日はお話してくれてありがとうございましたでは明日まってますので＾＾
dialogue.English: Thank you for talking with me today. I’ll be waiting for you tomorrow. ^^

dialogue.content: 明日またきます
dialogue.English: I’ll come again tomorrow.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとう待ってますね！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I’ll be waiting!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: では、今日はゆっくり休んでくださいね失礼します
dialogue.English: Well then, please get some good rest tonight. Goodbye for now.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました。凄く焦りましたが勉強させていただけました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. I was very flustered, but this was a great learning experience.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそむずかしいですよね私もわからないですが勉強になりました）
dialogue.English: (Same here. It's difficult, isn't it? I'm not sure what to do either, but it was a good learning experience for me too.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: (又、お会いしたらよろしくお願いいたします。今日は本当にありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (If we meet again, I look forward to working with you. Thank you so much for today.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (Likewise, I look forward to it.)

dialogue.content: (では、終了ボタン押させていただきますね)
dialogue.English: (Okay, I'm going to press the 'end' button now.)

dialogue.content: （はい）
dialogue.English: (Okay.)

dialogue.content: (失礼いたします)
dialogue.English: (Goodbye.)

dialogue.content: （失礼します）
dialogue.English: (Goodbye.)
